description: This file defines an interface 'PolicyTreeNode' for nodes within a policy tree structure, including nested types, methods for managing child nodes, and visitor pattern support.

classes.name: PolicyTreeNode
classes.description: Interface representing a node in a policy tree, providing methods for node identification, child management, and visitor acceptance.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of this node.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type (RESOURCE or SUBJECT) of this node.

methods.name: getChild
methods.description: Retrieves an optional containing a child node with the specified resource name.

methods.name: computeIfAbsent
methods.description: Gets or creates a child node with the specified resource name using a mapping function.

methods.name: getChildren
methods.description: Returns a map of all child nodes.

methods.name: addChild
methods.description: Adds a child node to this node.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a visitor to evaluate this node.
